APP.NAME: Tasks
APP.TAGLINE: Sign in to manage your Google Tasks

AUTH.HANDOFF_FAILED: Sign-in couldn't return to the page. Close this window and try again.

SETTINGS.TITLE: Settings
SETTINGS.SIGNED_OUT: Sign in to manage your settings.

EXPORT.TITLE: Export task lists
EXPORT.DESCRIPTION: Download the selected lists, including completed tasks and their kanban boards, as JSON.

IMPORT.TITLE: Import task lists
IMPORT.DESCRIPTION: Add the tasks and kanban boards from an exported JSON file. Lists are matched by title and created when missing.
IMPORT.NO_BOARDS: This file has no kanban boards. Export again from the store that has them.
IMPORT.FAILED: Import failed. Check the file and try again.

TASK_LISTS.DELETE_ALL_DESCRIPTION: Delete every task list and all of their tasks? Google keeps its default list, which can't be deleted. This can't be undone.
TASK_LISTS.DELETE_ALL_DESCRIPTION_RECREATED: Delete every task list and all of their tasks? An empty default list is recreated. This can't be undone.
TASK_LISTS.TITLE: Task lists
TASK_LISTS.DEFAULT_UNDELETABLE: The default list can't be deleted
TASK_LISTS.DELETE_DESCRIPTION: Delete "{title}" and all of its tasks? This can't be undone.
TASK_LISTS.FAILED: Couldn't update your task lists. Try again.

ACCOUNT.TITLE: Account
ACCOUNT.LOCAL_MODE: You're using Tasks without signing in, so your tasks are saved only in this browser. Signing in switches to your Google Tasks; local tasks stay here.
ACCOUNT.LOCAL_MODE_SIGNED_IN: You're in local mode, so tasks are saved only in this browser. You're still signed in to Google; leaving local mode returns to your Google Tasks.
